summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp filed an 8-K announcing a $250 million share repurchase program and a quarterly dividend of $0.37 per common share. The buyback may be executed via open market or private transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, through May 5, 2027. Management has discretion over timing and amounts; the program is non-binding. The board declared dividends on common and Series A preferred stock. This is an ordinary capital allocation action; no takeover/merger or activist campaign. Watch for repurchase pace and any acceleration if shares trade at a discount to tangible book value.
